name: eg-grafana
description: EnjoyGaming Grafana (grafana.enjoygaming.live) for the BI team: read dashboards and datasources, and create / update the BI alert rules kept in BI_alerting_system (alerts/<name>/query.sql on the ProdCH ClickHouse datasource), following the team's alert conventions. Ships the official Grafana MCP server (Docker, stdio) preconfigured for the company instance; the service account token comes from GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.
